# Sample Story

## The Search

A traveller asked the teacher for help, and the teacher replied:

> "Bring me one seed from a house where no one has died."

The traveller went from door to door. At each door the answer was the same.

> "Every house has lost someone," said the neighbour. "You are not alone."

## The Return

The traveller came back with empty hands and an open heart.
